tips.title: Did you know?
tips.search: Search by name, phone or ID to jump straight to a customer's thread.
tips.humanHandoff: When a conversation needs a human, hit "Take over" to reply as an operator — the bot steps back until you resume it.
tips.whatsappWindow: The WhatsApp 24h window is tracked for you. Once it closes, the customer must write first before you can reply.
tips.quickReplies: Type "/" in the composer to insert a canned response and answer common questions in a click.
tips.keyboard: Enter sends your reply; Shift + Enter adds a new line.
